configurations.name: backend
runtimeArgs: cd backend && [ -x .venv/bin/python ] || python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt --quiet && exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload

configurations.name: frontend
runtimeArgs: cd frontend && ([ -d node_modules ] || npm install) && npm run web
